record.paper_title: Two open problems in graph theory
record.original_question: If one is given only the set of vertex-deleted subgraphs of a finite graph, with duplicate isomorphic cards removed and multiplicities forgotten, is the original graph uniquely determined by that set?

evidence.quote: As is usual in mathematics, when one problem can’t be solved, mathematicians try another related problem. It is natural to ask if graphs are set reconstructible. That is, given the collection of vertex-deleted subgraphs, remove repetitions and then try to reconstruct the original graph(s).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph on vertex set $V(G)$ with $|V(G)| \ge 4$. For each vertex $v \in V(G)$, let $G - v$ denote the vertex-deleted subgraph obtained by removing $v$ and all edges incident to it. Define the deck-set of $G$ to be
$$\mathcal{S}(G) = \{[G-v] : v \in V(G)\},$$
where $[G-v]$ denotes the isomorphism class of $G-v$, and where $\mathcal{S}(G)$ is considered as a set (so isomorphic vertex-deleted subgraphs are identified and multiplicities are discarded).

A graph $G$ is said to be set-reconstructible if every finite simple graph $H$ with $\mathcal{S}(H) = \mathcal{S}(G)$ is isomorphic to $G$.

Question: Is every finite simple graph on at least four vertices set-reconstructible? Equivalently, do there exist non-isomorphic finite simple graphs $G$ and $H$, each with at least four vertices, such that $\mathcal{S}(G) = \mathcal{S}(H)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The set reconstruction conjecture (a strengthening of the Kelly–Ulam reconstruction conjecture, proposed by Harary) is widely reported to remain open. It has been verified computationally for all graphs on at most a small number of vertices (McKay's computations), but no general proof or counterexample is known.

status_evidence.title: Reconstruction conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Harary suggested a stronger version of the conjecture: any two graphs with at least four vertices and having the same sets of vertex-deleted subgraphs are isomorphic.
status_evidence.claim: The set reconstruction conjecture is a known strengthening of the reconstruction conjecture and remains an open problem.

status_evidence.title: The reconstruction conjecture for finite simple graphs and associated directed graphs
status_evidence.snippet: The Kelly–Ulam Reconstruction Conjecture remains very much open.
status_evidence.claim: The reconstruction conjecture (and its set-version strengthening) is still open in general.
